title: The Volley (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-rock 118 bpm crisp acoustic guitar punchy bass tight snare hand claps horn stab call-and-response light Spanish phrase accent drilling cadence pickleball training song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paddle up paddle up at the kitchen line
Ready ready ready every time
Short backswing short backswing punch through
Contact out front the volley is true

[Pre-Chorus]
Volley volley volley volley
Punch and finish trolley trolley
Volley volley volley volley
Firm wrist follow rally rally

[Chorus]
This is the volley keep it short keep it tight
No big swing just a punch in flight
Volley volley volley volley aim it down
Volley volley volley volley earn the ground

[Verse 2]
Shoulder turn small shoulder turn quick
Meet the ball don't let it tick
Paddle face slightly closed for the down
Volley deep make the rivals frown

[Bridge]
Ready position split step low
Elbow in paddle out in the show
Firme firme firme contact
Volley wins the kitchen pact

[Outro]
Volley volley volley short and clean
Volley volley volley keep it mean
